description: Retrieval gold set for AYUR-IP. Every expected provision was verified to exist in the ingested corpus (data/processed/chunks.jsonl) before being written here. Questions mix paraphrase, exact-citation, domain terminology and Ayurveda-specific phrasing so the evaluation exercises both the dense and lexical retrievers.
